tooltip.eicore.flavor_box.collect: Sneak-right-click a container to collect untasted foods
tooltip.eicore.flavor_box.taste: Hold right-click for 8 seconds to taste all new foods
tooltip.eicore.flavor_box.rules: No food-type limit, one per type, no duplicates; tasted foods stay inside
message.eicore.flavor_box.nothing_new: No extractable new untasted foods were found.
message.eicore.flavor_box.no_container: No accessible supported container. Check permissions, lid clearance, or packed/linked state.
message.eicore.flavor_box.collection_err: Collection stopped (%s foods saved). Check the log; uncommitted extracted food returns to inventory or drops safely.
message.eicore.flavor_box.no_food: There are no untasted foods in this box.
message.eicore.flavor_box.food_error: A food failed to finish consumption. Further tasting stopped; check the log.
tooltip.eicore.bread_fanatic: Consumes bread within 2 blocks: 11000 mana over 6 seconds.
tooltip.eicore.cow: Consumes beef within 2 blocks: cooked 20000, raw 14000 mana. Kills adult cows for 30000 mana.
tooltip.eicore.eat_iron: Consumes one iron block above or beside it each second for 1000 mana.
tooltip.eicore.agricultural: Crop growth within 4 horizontal / 2 vertical blocks: 100 mana, or 750 when mature.
tooltip.eicore.running_machine: The placing player sprints on the ground within 1 block for 500 mana per tick. Sneak to exit.
tooltip.eicore.quest: The placing team completes a quest within 16 blocks in the same dimension: 20000 mana, once per quest per flower.
tooltip.eicore.generating_flower: Bind to a mana spreader within 6 blocks using a Wand of the Forest.
